text: Koohooɓe tedduɓe ɓen ka yimɓe makko yedduɓe Alla, ɓe fenni Laakara on e ko woni ton kon immorde mbarjaari e Lepte, ko Men yaajinani ɓe kon immorde e neemaaji ka ngurdan aduna bewini ɓe. Ɓe wi'ani jokkuɓe ɓe ɓen e puyɓe maɓɓe ɓen- : "Oo wonaali si wanaa ɓanndunke yeru mooɗon himo ñaama ko ñaamoton kon, himo yara ko yaroton kon, o maraa ko senndi mo e mooɗon haa tawa o imminee Nulaaɗo faade e mooɗon".
